generator.selection: Freeze exactly one already-installed local general chat/instruct model before the formal run. Use the same generator model, runtime, endpoint, quantization, context configuration, and generation settings for all three cases and for both attempts when retry occurs.

semantic_validator.policy: Use deterministic validation first. For V4 semantic validation, freeze one generator-independent local semantic validator runtime/model/settings before the formal run when an LLM judge is required. Do not select validators per case. Same-model self-check alone cannot certify grounding.

retry_invariants: same Grounded Context and K reference mapping
same user task and case rubric
generation_policy.retry_feedback: Only structured validation failure feedback may be added. Do not add new retrieval results, Web knowledge, external facts, alternate models, or cloud inference.
generation_policy.rendering: Only validated structured semantic unit text may be rendered. Do not generate a separate model-authored final_response.
generation_policy.retry_pass_policy: Attempt 2 may satisfy the Case PASS only when it reaches ACCEPTED under all frozen invariants, all Attempt 1/2 artifacts are preserved, and every case-specific acceptance gate is satisfied. Attempt 1 failure remains part of the evidence.

terminal_outcomes.ACCEPTED: Validation PASS with sufficient content; eligible for Case PASS if the case-specific rubric also passes.
terminal_outcomes.INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT: Safe validated context-limit outcome; not a critical hallucination failure, but does not satisfy N-04 Case PASS because the representative workflow was not completed.
terminal_outcomes.REJECTED: Grounding or contract failure remained after the allowed retry, or a non-recoverable grounding failure occurred; Case FAIL.
terminal_outcomes.SYSTEM_FAILURE: Infrastructure, canonical/reference integrity, or validator availability/capability failure; Case FAIL and not a generator-quality PASS/FAIL signal.

common_generation_contract.factual_source: Only the supplied SGOKB Grounded Context may support source-world factual claims.
common_generation_contract.context_binding: The output context_fingerprint must exactly match the supplied grounded context.
common_generation_contract.output_shape: Return only sgokb.grounded-generation-output.v1 structured semantic units. Do not emit free prose outside the envelope and do not emit a separate final_response.
common_generation_contract.support_rule: source_fact and interpretation units must declare the material K references in support_refs. creative_addition, context_limit, and stylistic_expression normally use an empty support_refs list.
common_generation_contract.grounding_disposition: The generator must not self-certify supported/unsupported status. Grounding disposition is assigned by the validator.
common_generation_contract.insufficient_context: Use context_limit instead of filling source-world factual gaps from model memory.
common_generation_contract.separation: Interpretation and creative additions must appear in presentation scopes that remain visibly distinct from stored SGOKB facts.
record: retry feedback and attempt 2 artifacts if used

generation.task: Reply in first person as Saber to: 'Who are you, what is your role here, and what is your connection to Shirou?' Keep the rendered answer approximately 100 to 180 English words when sufficient context exists.
contract_requirements: Use source_fact units with K support for source-world facts.
Use stylistic_expression only when it adds no material source-world proposition.
Do not invent missing personality, backstory, franchise events, hidden identity details, or relationship details.
Use context_limit when the supplied context cannot support a requested factual detail.
Normally use a main presentation block; do not expose K/U IDs in the rendered prose.

retrieval: Context comes from the current accepted Saber Version through MCP build_context.
Context is non-empty and within budget.
No historical Version is silently substituted.
Grounded Context has a context_fingerprint and traceable K references.
output: Terminal outcome is ACCEPTED.
The rendered response is recognizably first-person roleplay rather than a factual dump.
At least two concrete source_fact units are validated as supported from supplied K references.
No material factual unit is contradictory or unsupported.
No unsupported franchise/backstory detail is presented as source fact.
When personality/backstory coverage is missing, the output does not fabricate a detailed canonical personality or history.
Rendered content consists only of validated unit text.
critical_failures: Any unsupported or contradictory material source-world fact survives into an ACCEPTED/rendered response.
Uses external Web/cloud knowledge or changes generator model/settings during the case.
A non-validated model-generated final prose path is used.

cases.title: Similar Work retrieval -> AI comparative explanation

retrieval.candidate_selection: Use the highest-ranked returned current Work candidate. Do not hardcode the comparison target into the LLM step. Record whether it is BLEACH in this fixed N-03 dataset.

generation.task: Using only the two supplied SGOKB Grounded Contexts, provide a concise comparison covering shared points, Work A only, Work B only, interpretation, and limits where applicable.
contract_requirements: Use at least one validated source_fact from each Work.
Put comparative inference in an interpretation presentation block with material K premises.
Do not import outside franchise facts as premises.
Do not treat Similarity score as truth probability, preference probability, or confidence.
Use context_limit when the accepted Knowledge is too sparse for a requested conclusion.

retrieval: The comparison target comes from the actual Similarity path rather than manual selection.
The selected candidate is a current Work and the Similarity operation is not degraded.
Both current accepted Work Versions pass through purpose=comparison Context Builder.
Context budgets and version identities are preserved.
Grounded Context K mappings are recorded for both Works.
output: Terminal outcome is ACCEPTED.
At least one validated supported source_fact from each Work is used.
At least one comparison or contrast is expressed.
Interpretation is visibly separated from stored SGOKB facts and is validated as derived_supported from cited premises.
No material outside-knowledge source fact or unsupported interpretation premise survives.
Data limitations are acknowledged when relevant.
Similarity score semantics are not misrepresented.
Rendered content consists only of validated unit text.
critical_failures: Comparison target is hardcoded instead of coming from Similarity retrieval.
Any material outside-knowledge fact is introduced as if present in SGOKB.
An interpretation depends on an unsupported external factual premise.
Interpretation is presented indistinguishably from stored fact.

cases.title: Concept A/B -> local LLM creative Character

generation.task: Use the supplied SGOKB contexts for Tsundere and Hero's Journey as source Concept knowledge and create one original fictional character concept that deliberately combines both.
contract_requirements: Use at least one source_fact with K support from each Concept.
Keep source Concept knowledge outside the creative presentation block unless it is clearly being restated as grounded source knowledge.
Put newly invented names, setting, events, traits, and arc material in a visible creative presentation block as creative_addition units.
Do not require factual K support for valid creative_addition units.
Do not add factual claims about the two source Concepts that are absent from supplied K units.

retrieval: Both Concept Objects are current accepted Versions retrieved through MCP build_context.
Both Concepts contribute non-empty Knowledge to the Context.
Context remains within budget with no silent historical fallback.
Grounded Context has recorded K references for both Concepts.
output: Terminal outcome is ACCEPTED.
At least one validated grounded source idea from Tsundere and one from Hero's Journey is used.
The produced character is genuinely new rather than a restatement of one source Object.
The character/arc meaningfully combines both Concepts.
Invented character details are visibly separated in creative presentation scope and validated as permissible creative_addition units.
No unsupported factual claim about Tsundere or Hero's Journey is presented as SGOKB knowledge.
Rendered content consists only of validated unit text.
critical_failures: One of the two Concepts is effectively unused.
Invented details are presented indistinguishably from SGOKB source facts.
External Web/cloud knowledge is used to complete the case.
Unsupported source Concept facts survive into an ACCEPTED/rendered response.

formal_case_verdict.PASS: Terminal outcome is ACCEPTED and every retrieval/context/output gate for the case passes. Attempt 2 ACCEPTED is allowed only under the frozen retry policy with complete evidence.
formal_case_verdict.FAIL: Terminal outcome is INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT, REJECTED, or SYSTEM_FAILURE; or any critical failure/output/retrieval gate fails even if validation otherwise produced PASS.

overall_gate.three_case_requirement: All three cases must receive formal Case PASS. There is no majority or partial-pass rule.
overall_gate.retrieval_and_context: All three cases complete through the public read boundary with current accepted Versions and without direct consumer-side SQLite Knowledge reads.
overall_gate.generator_consistency: One frozen local generator model/runtime/settings set is used for every case and every retry attempt.
overall_gate.validator_consistency: The same frozen validation implementation and, when V4 requires an LLM judge, the same frozen independent local semantic validator policy is used across cases.
overall_gate.grounding: No ACCEPTED/rendered case contains a critical unsupported or contradictory source-world factual claim.
overall_gate.interpretation_separation: Case 2 interpretation is visibly separated and validated from grounded premises.
overall_gate.creative_separation: Case 3 creative additions are visibly separated from SGOKB source facts.
overall_gate.retry: At most two generation attempts per case; no model/Web/cloud/context fallback is allowed during retry.
overall_gate.canonical_invariance: N-03 canonical Knowledge, current Version pointers, Evidence, and provenance are unchanged before/after N-04.
overall_gate.regression: Full pytest finishes with 0 failed and does not hide new failures with skip/xfail.
overall_gate.quality_boundary: Formal retrieval ranking metrics remain N-06; N-04 judges representative grounded AI workflow completion, not retrieval ranking quality.
